name: io.github.ihuzaifashoukat/x-use
title: X-Use - X (Twitter) MCP Server
description: Research X (Twitter), read inboxes and review publishing through MCP. No X API key required.

environmentVariables.name: X_USE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Absolute private directory for configuration, cookies, action journals and account state. Keep this stable across MCP client working directories.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only needed for server-side text generation ('auto' replies, composite draft tools, background automation). Interactive MCP use is keyless because the calling agent writes the text.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenAI-compatible endpoint, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Defaults to api.openai.com.
